proposed_widenings.name: ModifyBaseAcOperation (new OngoingOperation variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: Mage Armor's core mechanic is an ongoing effect that sets the target's base AC to a formula (13 + DEX modifier). OngoingOperation currently only has RollModifierOperation and DamageOnHitOperation. Neither can express an AC modification. A new OngoingOperation variant is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier

proposed_widenings.name: AcFormula: set_base (constant + ability_mod) vs flat delta
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing modify_ac in ReactionEffect takes delta: number (a flat addend, used by Shield). Mage Armor sets base AC to a computed formula: fixed constant (13) plus the target's DEX modifier. This is not expressible as a flat delta — it replaces the base, not adds to it. A formula-typed AC value (e.g. { kind: 'set_base'; base: number; ability: Ability }) is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.

notes: Mage Armor is mechanically simple — Action cast, Touch, 8-hour timed (non-concentration), sets base AC on one willing unarmored target. It fits the ongoing_effect container perfectly except that OngoingOperation has no AC-modification variant. The spell also ends on a state transition (target dons armor), which is a self_break / condition-based expiry — currently expire only supports duration-based termination, though the armor-donning condition might be representable as a self_break lifecycle atom. Primary blocker is the missing OngoingOperation variant.
